name: VmMaintenance
summary: Fleet maintenance console for Windows servers and Azure VMs, with a host agent run inside RDP/RDM.

programs.extractor: Resources/VmmHostAgent.ps1 template -> VmmExtractor.ps1 (any host) / VmmExtractor_<HOST>_<time>.ps1 (with plan); writes VMM_<HOST>_<time>.vmm on the host desktop; Manager imports from Collect.InboxFolders

time_rules.business_hours: Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00: read-only + staging to C:\Temp + the Azure start snapshot (SnapStart, Policy.SnapStartInBusinessHours)

security.store: AES-256-CBC + HMAC-SHA256, key under DPAPI CurrentUser
security.repo_leak_check: Tools/Test-Sanitized.ps1 (-History for the whole git history)

future: MCP server for an approved work AI model

status: Written and statically checked; not yet executed in PowerShell.
creator: Kay (GitHub: Hello-My-Name-Is-Kay)

os_policy.disk_expand: Azure, after business hours only, no override (VM deallocated)

media_repository.root: OS images named Win_Server_<version>_<LANG>.iso (e.g. Win_Server_2019_FR_FR.iso; _ or -, any case)
media_repository.host_folders: <share>\<HOST>\* = files only that host needs (SQL Server updates)
media_repository.pick: image for Staging.OsMediaVersion in the host's install language (Win32_OperatingSystem.OSLanguage); no fallback language

inventory.fields: VmMaintenance/Resources/InventoryFields.psd1 (24 columns, CSV order, help text, agent service names)
inventory.auto: fleet check (CIM), host agent / collector Get-InvProbe -> Inv.<Key>= lines -> record.InventoryAuto
inventory.manual: record.Inventory via Set-VmmInventoryValue / I screen; Inventory.Defaults

handoff.what: hands-on staging fallback when the terminal copy fails: vmm opens a remote desktop client, the operator copies, vmm verifies
handoff.commands: vmm handoff -HostName x [-Client Ask|Rdp|Rdm|RdcMan|None] [-Outbox Ask|Always|Never] | -VerifyOnly | -Report; vmm rdp -HostName x | -List
handoff.keys: T on a host or on the Stage guide (handoff), L (open RDP/RDM/RDCMan); offered by the Stage step when Copy-VmmStagingPackage fails (Handoff.Offer)
handoff.clients: Rdp = mstsc + one-off .rdp (clipboard, only needed drives as \\tsclient); Rdm = RemoteDesktopManager.exe /Template:<Handoff.RdmTemplate> /Host:<host>; RdcMan = one-off .rdg; no credentials passed or stored
handoff.host_script: Get-VmmHandoffScript: PS 2.0+, writes only in Staging.TargetFolder, copies from share or \\tsclient, prints VMMSTAGE1|HOST|file*bytes*sha256|... and puts it on the clipboard
handoff.verify: Get-VmmHandoffEvidence: VMMSTAGE1 report > WinRM (hash on host) > admin share > WMI CIM_DataFile (size); Stage marked Success only when every file is verified and Precheck is done
handoff.rules: client OS refused without order; business hours only into C:\Temp; all steps in the day log

host_import: CSV: hostname or FQDN, domain, IP (Read-VmmHostCsv: , ; tab, optional header); record.Fqdn used to connect, IPv4 fallback

logging.day_log: <data>/../logs/vmm_yyyyMMdd.log, masked then encrypted per line, Log.KeepDays 30
logging.cli: Invoke-VmmCli logs Command:, returned objects (Output), done/FAILED with duration; vmm.ps1 logs the exit code
logging.tables: Out-VmmHost prints and logs (Output, max 400 lines); never use Out-Host
logging.errors: errors.log (sanitized, 1 MB) plus an Error line in the day log
logging.read: vmm log [-Follow] [-Tail] [-Level] [-Find] [-Date] [-List] [-Export]; F2 pane, F3 full log

maintenance.auto_backup: one encrypted fleet store copy per day at start (Maintenance.AutoBackup, KeepBackups 14) in data\backups

sql_update_fetch.command: vmm fetch [-Preview] [-HostName a,b]  (F on the staging screen)
sql_update_fetch.target: per instance from the last check (PatchLevel -> build, SQL setup language or OS language), dbatools Test-DbaBuild -Latest or SqlUpdates.MaxBehind; SP first when the target CU belongs to a newer SP
sql_update_fetch.cache: each KB downloaded once into Downloads.CacheFolder (default <share>\_Downloads\SQL\<KB>), Microsoft Authenticode signature required, .sha256 written; then copied into <share>\<HOST>\ unless a file with that KB is there
sql_update_fetch.never: installs nothing; Windows Server ISO stays a manual download (licensed media, no API)
sql_update_fetch.needs: dbatools (Install-Module dbatools -Scope CurrentUser), internet from the laptop

agent_health.agents: Qualys, CrowdStrike, Zabbix, Ivanti, LansweeperAgent (Resources/InventoryFields.psd1: Services + Agent = @{ Products; Drivers; Ports; Log })
agent_health.verdict: Get-AgentVerdict in Resources/VmmHostAgent.ps1 (PS 2.0), pasted by AST into the fleet check script and the RDP collector: FAIL = not installed / service not running / driver not running; WARN = start type not Auto, port, log older than Agents.LogMaxAgeHours, version below Agents.MinVersion.<Key>
agent_health.where: inventory columns ('OK - Running, v7.16...'), Check.Agents per host, vmm agents [-Problems], A on a host, fleet check table, host health Warn on FAIL (Agents.AffectHealth)

snapshot.principle: terminal first, hands-on last; read-only everywhere
snapshot.command: vmm snapshot [-Name a,b] (menu 3, S on a host); vmm access tests routes only
snapshot.routes: Fleet.Routes, default DCOM (TCP 135) > WinRM (5985) > WinRM-SSL (5986); first that answers is used; stored per host in Access {At, Route, Ports, Why, Tried}
snapshot.hands_on: only when every route fails: Export-VmmHostAgent -Generic is built, steps printed; a failed terminal read never erases Extractor facts
snapshot.extractor: snapshot-only by default: steps code between VMM-STEPS-BEGIN/END is cut out at build; writes one encrypted result file on the host desktop; Problem= line per failed read; Extractor.AllowSteps=true adds steps to the per-host file only
snapshot.laptop: no TrustedHosts or firewall change; Fleet.WindowsLicence=false skips the licence query

theme.where: Private/Get-VmmTheme.ps1 (only place colours are defined), Write-VmmColor, ConvertTo-VmmColorRole, Write-VmmTuiLine
theme.palette: blue-black background (4,16,27); deep iceberg blue (24,92,138) for the top bar and the selected row; deep blue key bar (10,38,58); iceberg (124,188,232) for titles and section headers; ice-tinted text (196,214,229) and blue-grey hints (98,128,153); green/orange/red only for statuses
theme.rule: colour marks a status, it does not paint a row: list rows carry a one-cell status block and neutral text
theme.fallback: UI.TrueColor Auto|true|false: 24-bit escape sequences when the console takes them, else 16 console colours (DarkBlue, DarkCyan, DarkYellow); --no-color = plain
theme.background: Set-VmmConsoleBackground redefines console palette entry 0 (OSC 4) while the UI runs and restores it (OSC 104) on exit; UI.DeepBackground=false keeps black; only with 24-bit colour

single_instance.where: Private/Enter-VmmInstanceLock.ps1, Exit-VmmInstanceLock.ps1; called by Invoke-VmmCli and Save-VmmStore; released on module removal
single_instance.how: exclusive open handle on <data>/vmm.lock; vmm.lock.txt holds pid|start|command; error id VmmInstanceLocked, exit code 6
